channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. Awaits Tehran’s Response to Peace Proposal
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: US Imposes Sanctions On Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Over Support To Iran
item.description: The United States imposed sanctions on Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadly for allegedly helping Iran avoid sanctions and export oil through Iraq. The move is part of US efforts to restrict Iran's oil exports.

item.title: Apollo’s Marc Rowan Warns of Fallout From ‘Massive Geopolitical’ Shift
item.description: Apollo Global Management's Marc Rowan warned of significant consequences from a major shift in global politics. He did not specify what triggered the shift or what the fallout might be.

item.title: Why has the US sanctioned Iraq’s deputy oil minister for helping Iran?
item.description: The US sanctioned Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadly for allegedly helping Iran circumvent sanctions and export oil through Iraq. The move is part of US efforts to restrict Iran's oil exports.

item.title: Wisconsin’s Cybersecurity Leadership Spotlight
item.description: Wisconsin Governor Tony Evers highlighted the state's cybersecurity leadership during a recent event. The state's efforts aim to strengthen its defenses against cyber threats. Wisconsin’s Cybersecurity Leadership Spotlight securityboulevard. com.

item.title: Israel Says It Killed a Hezbollah Chief Near Beirut, Testing the Truce
item.description: Israel killed a Hezbollah chief near Beirut in a strike that tested a fragile truce. The incident occurred near the Lebanese capital, where a cease-fire has curbed but not halted fighting.

item.title: Alarm raised as two drones crash in Nato country after crossing from Russia
item.description: Two drones crashed in a Nato country after crossing from Russia. Ukraine-Russia war latest: Alarm raised as two drones crash in Nato country after crossing from Russia The Independent.

item.title: 1,500 Ships Trapped In Gulf Due To Iran's Hormuz Blockade: UN Maritime Body
item.description: Iran's Hormuz blockade trapped 1,500 ships in the Gulf. The closure has led to a significant global surge in the price of hydrocarbons. 1,500 Ships Trapped In Gulf Due To Iran's Hormuz Blockade: UN Maritime Body.

item.title: Trump calls for ‘incitement’ charges against top Democrat Hakeem Jeffries
item.description: Trump called for charges against Democrat Hakeem Jeffries. US president says House minority leader should be indicted over 'maximum warfare' remarks in relation to election maps. Trump calls for ‘incitement’ charges against top Democrat Hakeem Jeffries.

item.title: Israeli Attack Kills Son Of Hamas Chief In Talks With Trump-Led Board
item.description: An Israeli attack killed the son of Hamas chief. Trump's Gaza plan involves Israeli withdrawal and Hamas disarmament, which remains disputed. Israeli Attack Kills Son Of Hamas Chief In Talks With Trump-Led Board.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal as Trump pressures Tehran for agreement on deal to end war
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal for a deal to end the war as Trump pressures Tehran for an agreement. Tehran denies allegations its forces were behind a blast on a Panama-flagged ship.

item.title: US-Iran ceasefire framework explained: Nuclear issue, Hormuz, key players, what’s left out and oil
item.description: The US and Iran are working on a ceasefire framework. US-Iran ceasefire framework explained: Nuclear issue, Hormuz, key players, what’s left out and oil.

item.title: Trump to Host Brazil’s President Lula at White House After Months of Ups and Downs
item.description: President Trump will meet Brazil's President Lula at the White House. President Trump and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who have had a rocky relationship, will meet on Thursday for talks on security, trade and critical minerals.

item.title: Rubio visits Vatican amid escalating tensions between Trump and Pope Leo
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Rome to preserve the relationship between Washington and the Holy See amid escalating tensions between Trump and Pope Francis. Secretary of State Marco Rubio traveled to Rome in an effort to preserve a crucial relationship between Washington and the Holy See.

item.title: Iran’s president says he has spoken to the country’s Supreme Leader
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says he has met with Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Iran’s president says he has spoken to the country’s Supreme Leader.

item.title: U.S. Awaits Iran’s Response to Latest Peace-Talks Proposal
item.description: The US is awaiting Iran's response to a latest peace-talks proposal. The development is part of ongoing diplomatic efforts to address tensions between the two nations. No details on Iran's stance have been released yet.

item.title: Myanmar junta claims recapture of trade artery towards China
item.description: Myanmar's military claims to have recaptured a trade artery to China, crushing "terrorist insurgent groups" along the route. The route links Mandalay to Myitkyina, near China's border.

item.title: Russia's Victory Day parade with no tanks a sign Ukraine war not going to plan
item.description: Russia's Victory Day parade in Moscow will feature soldiers but no military hardware, a first in nearly two decades. The absence of tanks is seen as a sign that the Ukraine war is not going as planned.

item.title: DMK authorises Stalin to take decisions for a ‘stable’ T.N. govt. | Above the Fold | 07.05.2026
item.description: The DMK authorized Stalin to make decisions for a stable Tamil Nadu government. From Tamil Nadu’s post-election power struggle with the DMK’s AIADMK dilemma to Bihar’s Cabinet expansion, one year of Operation Sindoor, and a deadly virus outbreak at sea - top stories of the day.

item.title: Iran’s President Pezeshkian says he met Supreme Leader Khamenei
item.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. What struck me most during this meeting was the vision and the humble and sincere approach of the supreme leader of the Islamic revolution, says President Masoud Pezeshkian.
